sourceClaims: -- Vaults of the Inquisition (map 936) and Road to De Other Side (map 937): melee per difficulty, measured.
-- The Heroic/Mythic templates took their DamageModifier from c = 857.1 (Vaults) and 199.2 (Road) damage per point at
-- level 60. Neither was measured; the core gives 118.3 per point to a class 1 and 112.4 to a class 2 creature of level
-- 60 (gameplay test script_melee_hit_taken), so Heroic and Mythic hit about 7x (Vaults) or 1.7x (Road) below their
-- logs (#10053: the Deceiver's Presence hit a level 60 player for 63 on Heroic). Heroic and Mythic now hit as their
-- logs: Mythic the 2026-08-05 log, Heroic Mythic / 2.15 for bosses and / 2.5 for the rest.
-- Normal keeps the level 25 targets of rev_20261029_81, which counted CoA.CreatureScaling.Dungeon.Damage (x1.5)
-- inside the 40.5 per point the test measured without it; spawned creatures take it on top, so the Normal values are
-- divided by 1.5. Where Normal would then hit harder at level 59 than Heroic at 60, it is held at Heroic.
-- Road's three bosses get Heroic/Mythic templates like its trash (their Normal target at level 25 is the Mythic log
-- times 0.12, the share of Road's trash). Generated by dungeon-recherche/custom_dungeon_melee.py.
-- Road to De Other Side bosses: Heroic and Mythic templates
notes: Author explicitly says earlier heroic/mythic tuning had a core damage-per-modifier mismatch
Values are source-authored and log-derived; not directly measured by this audit
